normalized_nm_diff.scope: aggregate object and final executable separately
normalized_nm_diff.interpretation: The focused symbol set is equal after ld -r; the split build changes object ownership and layout, not the final focused set.

normalized_nm_diff.scope: aggregate object and final executable separately
normalized_nm_diff.interpretation: The plain build inlines/removes all four non-template inline definitions and the max_of instantiation. The split header pieces are compiled with the splitter's observed -fkeep-inline-functions flag, so four weak definitions remain; max_of stays a template and has no emitted focused symbol at -O2.

size_and_layout_facts: At -O0, plain versus split final executable text is 13,486 versus 74,773 bytes; split is 61,287 bytes larger. At -O2 it is 4,150 versus 51,041 bytes; split is 46,891 bytes larger.
At -O0, plain versus split relocatable object text is 7,344 versus 58,465 bytes. At -O2 it is 1,131 versus 35,943 bytes.
The split final executable has the same bss at each optimization level (280 bytes), while data is 1,376 versus 872 at -O0 and 1,160 versus 728 at -O2.
The split object is an ld -r relocatable aggregate of one main piece plus four header pieces. The template body is present in the mirror/header tree but is not a separately linked object.
The measured split tree generated five header definitions, reported four compilable header object files, and kept max_of as a template. Main remained in the translation-unit piece.

generated_tree.source_path_note: The embedded source below replaces ephemeral /tmp absolute prefixes in #line directives with test/ paths; function bodies and generated structure are measured output.

caveats: This is measured output from ./cpp-splitter with g++ 14.3.0, not a manually reconstructed split. No project source was changed.

The repository-relative cpp-splitter binary is not on PATH. The first clang++ probe was not used for this evidence; the successful and reported runs are both plain g++ and actual splitter-plus-g++ runs.

The generated source from this binary does not visibly contain the __attribute__((used)) shown in the architecture document's illustrative snippet. Its verbose command instead adds -fkeep-inline-functions to header-piece GCC compiles. The artifact records the generated text actually observed.
The embedded #line paths are normalized only to remove ephemeral /tmp names. They are not invented source bodies.
nm addresses are intentionally normalized to <addr> for set comparison. Symbol type W means weak; T means text/global. size reports section totals, not source-function sizes.
The large split size is a property of this small fixture and this measured compiler/splitter invocation. It should not be presented as a general performance benchmark.
